title: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

head: prefix / primary meanings
examples / additional meanings
prepositional phrases
rows: **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-** — Movement upwards. Antonym: с-
Альпинист взошёл на гору. — The mountain climber walked up the mountain.
**на-** — Movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion

Туча наползла на солнце. — A cloud crept onto the sun. Other: Quantified movement: Водитель наездил 50 километров. — The driver covered 50 kilometers. Я налетал 2500 часов на Боинге 737. — I had 2500 flight hours in Boeing 737.

blocks.text: Temporal and resultative prefixes, from the same table: по- — Beginning of unidirectional movement, with unidirectional verb of motion: Я пошла в университет. — I went to the university. Other: 1. Intention to carry out a movement in the future: Зимой я собираюсь поехать во Флориду. — In the winter I plan to go to Florida. 2. Approximate location of the agent at moment of speech: Где папа? Он пошёл на работу. — Where's Dad? He went to (is at) work. по- — Slow and measured multidirectional movement, with multidirectional verb of motion: Она задумчиво походила по квартире и наконец решила уйти. — She walked around the apartment pensively and finally decided to leave.

Wiktionary's definition
rows: to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; to rise (of a heavenly body)
to fly up, to soar, to take off, to take wing; (figurative) to zoom
to run up (to run in an upward direction, e.g. up a hill)
to rise to the surface, to surface; (figurative) to appear, to pop up, to emerge

to fly (upon, against), to come flying (to); (colloquial) to bump (into), to run (into), to hit, to collide (with)
to run (against), to dash; (waves) to roll in, to coast in
